source: ADR #34 D12; GET http://127.0.0.1:9200/metrics, key session_slots
rules: read-only: the block writes nothing and reads no access counter
open slots and open operator sessions only; agent traces are counted, never listed
no slot body, no session summary, no client_key
the block's queries are not one snapshot: a bound session may briefly appear in slots but not in sessions
a type written a|b admits both; null means the value is not known
